from datetime import datetime

def forward(groups):
    date_part = groups[0]
    time_part = groups[2]
    text = f"{date_part} {time_part}"
    dt = datetime.strptime(text, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S,%f')
    return {'stored': [int(dt.timestamp() * 1000000)], 'layout': []}

def inverse(record):
    micros = int(record['stored'][0])
    dt = datetime.fromtimestamp(micros / 1000000)
    return dt.strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S,%f')[:23]
